recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If Financial Management still wants a distinct human-readable network label in Coverage, handle that as a fresh current-version change request rather than deriving it from FHIR-11383 during reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-11383 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Financial Management change request raised against DSTU2 Coverage to add groupDesc, subGroupDesc, planDesc, subPlanDesc, classDesc, and networkDesc, with the final resolution stating that elements were added as elementDisplay rather than elementDesc.
initial_application: Historical commit 4380617428 updated Coverage source and examples for tracker 11383 by adding groupDisplay, subGroupDisplay, planDisplay, subPlanDisplay, classDisplay, and subClassDisplay rows/examples and revising Coverage.network wording; it did not create a separate networkDisplay element.
additional_context: Coverage is active in the current build, and source/fhir.ini maps the old Coverage.grouping structure to Coverage.class. Later Published issue FHIR-15564 accepted the new Class structure to hold group, plan, and related card information and remove Grouping/Sequence. Current source defines Coverage.class.name as the human-readable description for the type/value pair, and examples use it for group, subgroup, plan, subplan, class, and subclass labels.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding a new Coverage.network display/name element now would be a new current-version model change not safely justified by the DSTU2 tracker history, while the classification display fields that survived the redesign are represented in current source by Coverage.class.name.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Coverage issue accepted the new Class structure to hold group, plan, and related card information and remove the older Grouping structure.
